## Skills

## Projects

- Farmer's Swag (Agricultural AI Platform): AI-powered agricultural decision-support web app with crop disease diagnosis and market pricing trackers. Built with React, FastAPI, Gemini API, Tailwind.
- Precedent (AI Legal Contract Reviewer): LLM tool that learns a firm's past contract decisions and reviews new agreements clause by clause.
- Finance AgentX (Personal Finance Decision Tool): checks upcoming income and recurring expenses to advise on purchases.
